subject: Human Evolution
title: Fat Lamps
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Fat Lamps.

hook.text: Deep inside caves, paintings cover walls far from any daylight. How did the artists see?

buildup.text: Stone lamps burning animal fat have been found in painted caves—simple bowls with a wick of moss.

discovery.text: Experiments show these lamps produce steady light for hours, enough to work or paint in total darkness.

twist.text: The flickering light would have animated cave paintings, making animals seem to move on the walls.

climax.text: Fat lamps turned impenetrable caves into illuminated spaces for art, ceremony, and deep-cave exploration.

punchline.text: Animal fat lit humanity's first art galleries.

quiz.question: How did ice age people light deep caves?
options: Stone lamps burning animal fat with moss wicks
